uncertainties: The driver walks sides rather than a recon slot's own triple, because this process builds no slot object. env.slot_index is set to the observing side, which 00804B2F indexes the target's detection record with, but the native slot index and the party coincide only inside the native rebuild.
The drain runs per target here, following gunnery_recon_detection's composition, while natively 008073C0 drains the flattened list once at 00807634.

kReconDetectionUnknownLevel is identified on purpose, so a side the pass never covers keeps the permissive pre-rule-(c) answer. A binder that wants a strict answer must change that constant deliberately.

008048A0, 00806840, 008073C0 and 008082A0 were NOT re-read by this packet. Everything about them here is cited from docs/GUNNERY_RECON_DETECTION.md, docs/RECON_SLOT_LISTS.md and the Ghidra plate comment at 00806840.
The sensor rows come from the authored tables in src/sensor_table_data.cpp, not from a live 008082A0 run, so a mission script that edits a sensor table at run time would diverge.
